articles.title: Joe Rogan Is Right About Ciryl Gane's Eye Pokes
articles.description: Chael Sonnen reacts to Joe Rogan's comments about Ciryl Gane's eye poke against Josh Hokit and raises a bigger question about how MMA handles fouls. Hokit was clearly poked in the eye but immediately continued fighting. Chael compares that reaction to Tom Aspinall's previous eye-poke situation and asks whether Hokit's toughness actually worked against him. If the foul itself doesn't change based on the fighter's reaction, why should the outcome? Chael breaks down the referee's decision, the rules surrounding accidental eye pokes, and why Hokit may have a legitimate argument for a rematch.

articles.title: Did the Judges Get the Josh Hokit Fight Wrong? #ufc
articles.description: Did the judges get the Josh Hokit fight wrong? Chael Sonnen isn't ready to call it a robbery, even though many people watching believed Hokit had done enough to win. Chael discusses the reaction to the scorecards, including the criticism directed at Daniel Cormier's interpretation of the fight. But the bigger conversation goes beyond one controversial decision. How should judges actually score an MMA fight? How much weight should be given to damage, aggression, and effective techniques? Chael has a clear opinion: it's time to simplify the UFC's scoring criteria. He believes damage and octagon control should be removed, leaving judges with just three words to guide their decisions: Effective combat techniques. It's a proposal that could change how fans, fighters, and judges look at every UFC fight. #UFC #JoshHokit #MMAScoring #UFCJudging #MMA #ChaelSonnen

articles.title: Was Josh Hokit Robbed? #ufc
articles.description: Was Josh Hokit robbed? Chael Sonnen admits he initially had Josh winning four rounds to none heading into the fifth, but after having more time to reflect, he's not ready to call the result a robbery. Chael explains why he was so impressed with Hokit. Giving up 17 pounds, Josh walked his opponent down, smothered him, and showed qualities that deserve plenty of recognition regardless of the final result. But does the fight deserve an immediate rematch? Chael doesn't think so. Instead, he has a much bigger prediction for Josh Hokit: Alex Pereira could be next. And if that matchup gets announced, Chael believes fans are going to go crazy. #UFC #JoshHokit #AlexPereira #MMA #ChaelSonnen #UFCNews

articles.title: How the Merab Incident Escalated #ufc
articles.description: The Merab Dvalishvili altercation has taken another turn after new footage revealed what allegedly happened five minutes before the incident. Chael Sonnen explains that the initial video made the Russians appear clearly responsible. But the second recording reportedly showed physical contact initiated by Merab toward a wrestler. According to Chael, the wrestlers then left and alerted the MMA group, setting the stage for what happened next. Now, Merab, Kamaru Usman, and others involved are reportedly being held in custody in connection with the incident. Even people who were only filming have reportedly been caught up in the situation. What started as a confrontation between fighters has become a much bigger situation, and the additional footage has changed the conversation. #MerabDvalishvili #KamaruUsman #UFC #MMA #ChaelSonnen #MMAnews

articles.title: One takedown could change everything for Josh Hokit #ufc
articles.description: Josh Hokit may be giving up size against Ciryl Gane, but Chael Sonnen believes that could create a very interesting matchup. Chael admits he's still unsure which fighter has the advantage. Gane is a physically impressive heavyweight, weighing close to 250 pounds, but he's not simply a big, slow heavyweight who can be bullied around. The question is what happens if Hokit gets him to the ground. Chael points to the quick takedown Hokit demonstrated against Derek and believes that if Josh can replicate that kind of explosive entry and get on top of Gane, the fight could look very different. In fact, Chael thinks Hokit could make Gane look bad. One takedown could change the entire fight. #UFC #JoshHokit #CirylGane #MMA #UFCNews #ChaelSonnen
